title: Variant mismatch watchdog and graceful degradation playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Follow-up ticket for the Feb 28 capacity/regression incident where cross-region reroutes combined with stale policy snapshots led to requests being replayed against incompatible model variants. This ticket codifies a watchdog + graceful degradation playbook: runtime-side detection of variant mismatches, immediate safe fallback rules, and improved telemetry to prevent silent loops and reduce blast radius.
impact_summary: During the incident ~12:14-12:46 UTC, ~0.8% of production requests hit a variant compatibility mismatch after a control-plane policy propagation lag. Affected customers experienced elevated latencies (p95 increased from 120ms -> 480ms) and ~2x token billing on retry storms. Several dedicated capacity pools saw load amplification leading to degraded throughput for 14 minutes.
root_cause: 1) Policy snapshot propagation delay across regions left routers using an older routing table while the model catalog tagged a variant as 'stable' -> 'deprecated' transition. 2) Router retry logic retried on mismatch with aggressive backoff disabled, causing thundering retries. 3) Telemetry lacked a distinct 'variant-mismatch' signal making the failure noisy and hard to triage.
timeline_summary: 2026-02-28 12:11 UTC: policy rollout begun. 12:14 UTC: first mismatch error rate spike detected by Ops. 12:17-12:30 UTC: automated retries and cross-region reroutes amplified traffic. 12:33 UTC: incident declared; emergency guardrails applied to pause rollout. 12:46 UTC: traffic stable after forced fallback to last-known-good variant and rate-limits. Post-incident: canonical postmortem created and immediate mitigations landed in hotfix PR #742.
action_items: Implement a variant-mismatch watchdog in router that emits a high-cardinality telemetry event and triggers an immediate soft-fallback to a compatible variant (OWNER: Marcus Chen, ETA: 2026-03-19)

Add a safety path in routing logic: if a mismatch is detected for >0.2% of requests in 1m window, switch to graceful-degradation mode that returns 'degraded' response header and routes to universal quantized variant (OWNER: Priya Rao, ETA: 2026-03-26)
Throttle cross-region auto-reroute escalation: introduce exponential backoff with jitter and a circuit-breaker threshold keyed by policy snapshot age (OWNER: SRE team / Kevin Lee, ETA: 2026-03-16)
Instrument variant compatibility at every hop: include chosen-variant checksum in request traces and KV cache keys to detect silent mismatches (OWNER: Runtime-Infra, ETA: 2026-03-22)
Enrich alerting and runbooks: new alert 'routing.variant_mismatch.rate' with runbook steps to pause rollouts and apply safe fallback (OWNER: Oncall Runbook Owner, ETA: 2026-03-12)
Create end-to-end test in CI that simulates staggered policy propagation and validates router fallback behavior (OWNER: QA, ETA: 2026-04-02)
Postmortem follow-up doc: consolidate learnings and schedule a weekly incident review for the routing subsystem for 2 cycles (OWNER: Aisha Patel, ETA: 2026-03-10)
Audit and reconcile model variant tagging in the catalog: add a pre-deploy consistency check between catalog tags and routing policies (OWNER: Model Onboarding, ETA: 2026-03-30)
Ship hotfix to limit automatic retries on mismatch responses to 2 attempts with exponential backoff (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/742) (OWNER: Marcus Chen, ETA: 2026-03-09)
Add metric to Console: per-route variant-mismatch rate and broken-variant list with sample request IDs for triage (OWNER: Console team, ETA: 2026-03-26)
acceptance_criteria: Router emits 'variant_mismatch' telemetry event for every mismatch and it's visible in the Console within 1 minute
Graceful-degradation mode activates automatically when the configured threshold is crossed in the canary region
Retry storm prevented in 95% of simulated policy-lag scenarios in CI test
Post-deploy traffic in canary remains within 10% of baseline latency and token cost after rollout with fault-injection enabled
